items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Tillman' in the context of listing band members (Bucku, Archie Robertson, Big Boy), but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship or interaction with Tillman, only narrating the band composition.

ctx.x: And who was that? Buck, you said?

Bucku. Bucku. My name is Bucku. What did he play? Bass Trouba. Bass Trouba. And Archie was on trombone. Archie, he's gone. There he is. Archie Robertson. Trombone player. Oh. Big Boy. Big Boy. Big Boy. Big Boy. Big Boy. Big Boy. Big Boy. What's your name? Tillman.
Tillman. Big Alright. Did he used to play with him?
